A '''manse''' was owned by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Adraas]] during the early days of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was surrounded by an eight-[[meter]]-tall wall. The main structure was in the center of a [[Garden/Legends|garden]] courtyard with a fountain, which reminded [[Darth Malgus]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. It was guarded by [[Imperial soldier]]s.<ref name="TOR-D" />

After the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and the events afterward, Darth Malgus traveled to the manse to eliminate his rival, Adraas. He [[Force jump/Legends|Force Jumped]] over the wall, overpowered the soldiers standing guard, and raged through the building, destroying sculptures and furniture, and [[Force bellow|yelling]] Adraas's name. When he found his rival, Malgus [[Duel in Adraas's manse|dueled]] him and eventually killed Adraas, choking him with his bare hands. His mission complete, Malgus left the rest of the manse unharmed.<ref name="TOR-D" />
